verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say that asking it to add login generates the signup and login pages, wires them to the backend, and protects user data with row level security. Its built-in Cloud backend, on a Supabase foundation, supports email, phone, Google, Apple, Microsoft, and SAML SSO sign-in. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the scaffolded auth flows, especially social providers, work as described.
